record.question: Nephrogenesis completes at what gestational age?
record.explanation: Answer C: 36 weeks. Human nephrogenesis is generally described as completing around 34–36 weeks’ gestation, though studies report individual variation. Thus 36 weeks is the closest conventional option, not an exact invariant cutoff. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK539840/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15060203/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5828465/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
